newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Raymond James starts biotechs.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Raymond James starts biotechs.

text.p: -- Raymond James Financial said it intiated coverage of five biotechnology companies.
-- Centocor Inc, ICOS Corp and Ligand Pharmaceuticals Inc were started with buy recommendations. SangStat Medical Corp was rated an accumulate and Cephalon Inc was rated neutral.
-- In afternoon Nasdaq trade, Centocor was off 1-1/4 to 32-3/8, ICOS was unchanged at 7-7/8 and Ligand Pharmaceuticals was off 1/4 at 13-3/8.
-- SangStat Medical shed 1/8 to 25-3/4 and Cephalon was at 19-7/16, off 1-3/16.
